title.narrative: ResCom Resilient Communities through Women Empowerment Phase II

description.narrative:
The project sets out to enhance women's economic empowerment in the context of impacts of climate change in Moldova, based on good practices from the predecessor project Sustainable and Resilient Communities through Women’s Empowerment (2020-2024, funded by Sweden). The main objective of the project is to ensure that the nexus between gender and climate is well understood and that gender equality is advanced in Moldova. Through four outcomes, the project is designed to lead to “a transformed landscape where climate action and gender equality converge, resulting in stronger communities and enhanced climate resilience”.
Outcome 1: Capacities of national and local authorities to advance gender transformative climate change actions are enhanced. Outcome 2: National and local women's leadership in climate actions is expanded and advanced. Outcome 3: Women led climate-smart solutions are identified, supported and replicated among women groups and target communities. Outcome 4: Women-led climate-smart solutions are disseminated, and societal awareness is raised.
UNDP will work with 25 target communities (around 70-75,000 persons comprising 20-25,000 households), both in rural and urban areas, including some municipalities participating in the voluntary amalgamation process. 80 women-led households and 20 women-led businesses will be engaged for implementation of climate smart solutions and initiatives. Target groups/beneficiaries of the project include Local Public Authorities (LPAs), business Incubators, women agri-producers and CSOs, as well as central authorities (Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Energy, Ministry of Agriculture and Food Industry). The project will also pilot three energy communities in Moldova.
